pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: JEI lists the wine recipes. Compare their listed effects; one bottle of each is enough, without aging.

pages.title: Choose a wine effect
pages.text: Wine can affect jumping, surface movement, defense or item attraction. Sneaking stops magnetic attraction; teleport wine searches forward along your gaze rather than selecting a random guaranteed-safe location.
